name: use-tab-observer
title: useTabObserver
description: Hook to observe active tab changes using ResizeObserver and MutationObserver.

docs.lead: A React hook that observes active tab changes within a tab list using ResizeObserver and MutationObserver. Useful for animating tab indicators or tracking the active tab index.

api.name: useTabObserver Options
api.description: Configuration options passed to the hook.

props.name: onActiveTabChange
props.description: Callback fired when the active tab changes. Receives the tab index and the DOM element.

api.name: useTabObserver Return Value
api.description: The object returned by the hook.

props.name: mounted
props.description: Whether the observer has mounted and performed its initial check.

props.name: listRef
props.description: Ref to attach to the tab list container element.
